navigation.latency_slow: Navigation tick takes %d ms at the median (about 110 ms is normal): screencap %d ms, image processing %d ms, localization %d ms, steering input %d ms, everything else %d ms. At this speed turns come too late, so the character tends to hit walls or fall into water. Try lowering the in-game graphics quality and resolution, closing heavy background programs, and checking whether GPU usage is too high. This notice does not interrupt the task.
navigation.sensitivity_mismatch: Navigation is consistently over-rotating: measured turns reach about %d%% of the commanded angle, where roughly 100%% is expected; this figure is the median over the last %d sampling windows. Over-rotation makes navigation correct its heading repeatedly, which can lead to hitting walls or falling into water. This is usually caused by raised in-game camera sensitivity or overly high mouse DPI; setting in-game sensitivity back to 0 and lowering mouse DPI should resolve it. This notice does not stop the task.
zipline.already_signed_in: Already signed in, no need to log in this time; the window will close automatically once all marks are captured.
zipline.import_done: Zipline coordinates updated: %d entries. To make navigation use ziplines wherever possible, set "Use ziplines when navigating" to "Always on" under the "Zipline" settings. With "Follow the task", ziplines are used only on routes that specify them.
zipline.no_data: Ziplines were not used on this route: no zipline coordinates are available for the current area. Run the "🛝 Import / Update Zipline Coordinates" task from the task list, then start this task again. This notice does not interrupt the task.
zipline.not_chosen: Ziplines were not used on this route: none of the ziplines in the current area passed the benefit check. Typical reasons are that reaching the mount point costs more than walking directly, the mount point lies outside the game's NPC-walkable area, or the landing point is too far from the destination. This notice does not interrupt the task.
